_: Human classification of every direction slot in pass after-A, against the five-way rubric registered in proof/eval-matrix/pre-registration.json. Every frame was opened and looked at. Pixel statistics were not used to decide a class. The images live outside the repo, under .release-artifacts/closure/27b-final/matrix-after-A/, because they are Google Maps Content.
contactSheets: sheet-<case>-f<floor>.png in the same directory, one per case, produced by proof/contact-sheet.mjs from the frames already captured. No enhancement of any kind.
method: Every rendered frame in after-A was opened as an image, in a per-case contact sheet carrying the direction's class, render state, note and pixel statistics beside it.
A direction with no frame was judged on whether the app said why, in the pane where the frame would have been.

after-B carries the same classes: all 44 direction slots are identical to after-A in class, render state, lead label, thumbnail state and note, and the 34 rendered frames differ by at most 0.01 edge energy and 0.0 luma. No frame was re-judged on that basis alone; the identical statistics are the evidence that there is nothing new to look at.
No frame was altered, upscaled, denoised or regenerated.

counts.note: 45 = 11 imagery cases x 4 directions, plus the invalid-address case, which has no directions and is counted once as a whole-case refusal.

appSaid.note: Still sharpening when this frame was captured.

incorrect.whatTheFrameShows: A near building surface with a hard horizontal top edge occupies roughly the lower 55-60% of the picture. Its top edge sits above the far horizon visible on the right of the same frame, so it stands higher than the camera rather than being a rooftop below it.
incorrect.whyIncorrect: Rubric class Incorrect covers 'an obstruction the app did not declare'. The other three directions of this same case are labelled Enclosed with a measured distance; this one carries the unqualified class and no obstruction note.
incorrect.reproduces: Yes, in both after-A and after-B (meanLuma 84.3, sdLuma 46.7, edgeEnergy 5.40 in both), and in the before pass of this sprint, and in the earlier closure-A/closure-B and gate-A/gate-B passes.
incorrect.notTouched: This is the open finding left for Adam. It is classifyBand() calling a half-blocked direction 'open'. The four band thresholds were fitted to sixteen directions with no held-out set, so moving one means re-judging the whole matrix. Nothing in this pass changed classifyBand, its thresholds, or any camera parameter.

borderline.why: The frame is partly a near surface and partly sky and trees, and the app declares 'Another building stands about 16 m from this side'. The declaration is present either way, so the class does not change any pass condition.

passConditions.no case classified Incorrect: FAIL — one, 432park floor 40 ESE, pre-existing and deliberately left for Adam. Reproduced in every pass on record.
passConditions.the invalid address produces a refusal a: PASS — 'Address not found', 0 root-tileset requests, 0 renderer tile requests, both passes.
passConditions.the blocked-imagery case produces the ho: PASS — four empty frames, each reading DIDN'T LOAD inside the frame and keeping its own obstruction measurement, plus the whole-result guarantee at the head.
passConditions.the Google attribution line is present a: PASS — 707.2 x 20.4 CSS px, withinDocument true, all 10 rendering cases, all three passes.
passConditions.no console error other than ones raised: PASS — 1 console error across each 12-case pass, and it is the blocked case's own session failure. The Cesium geocoder warning is declared separately as an expected notice.
